snippet.title: Haunted Bloodlines - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725610/Haunted_Bloodlines/

Haunted Bloodlines is a first-person survival, psychological horror game. In the dark rooms of an expanding mansion, a terrifying story unfolds. As the mansion breathes, hidden secrets lay within its walls. Survival depends on your own sanity. Always remember time can either be a friend or an enemy.

Connect with us:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/HauntedBloodlin
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hauntedbloodlines
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hauntedbloodlines

Find out more at https://www.iphigames.com
